note: Bench space: metres, +Y up, +Z towards the player (the player's right is -X), origin at the floor under the bench centre (the SS_Workbench prefab's own space). Generated by bench/make_greybox.py. A place with a `mark` takes its position (and, for a pose mark, its rotation) from that mark of the real family; pos and rot are the greybox fallback, in the owner part's space. `real` gives where a real family's GLB root goes.
